data.one_liner: Flutter widget for creating customizable single or multi-select ChoiceChip lists.
data.what_it_does: Creates a customizable horizontal or vertical list of ChoiceChips that allows single or multi-selection. It tracks selected chip indices directly without external state management and supports wrapping.
use_when: You need a simple list of choice chips for filtering or selection options.
You want customizable colors, borders, and text styles per chip.
You need multi-select or single-select chip functionality without heavy state management setup.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions like Riverpod or Bloc for handling selections.
You need heavily specialized non-choice chip Material components not supported by the wrapper.
strengths: Easy to set up and customize background, text, and border colors per chip.
Supports multi-select and wrapping content using standard wrap properties.
Exposes selected indices directly for straightforward integration with other UI widgets.
weaknesses: Index tracking list must not be marked as constant or the widget will not respond to interactions.
data.minimal_example:
ChipList(
  listOfChipNames: const ['Beagle', 'Labrador', 'Retriever'],
  activeBgColorList: [Colors.blue],
  inactiveBgColorList: [Colors.white],
  activeTextColorList: [Colors.white],
  inactiveTextColorList: [Colors.blue],
  listOfChipIndicesCurrentlySelected: [0],
)
